# HiAPI Image to Prompt Agent Skill

Turn one reference image into a prompt that makes an image model regenerate a similar image (general, GPT Image, Midjourney, FLUX, Stable Diffusion; English or Chinese). Default path uses the Agent's own vision with no key; optional script calls HiAPI chat/completions (deepseek-v4.1-flash, json_object) with the user's HIAPI_API_KEY.
